scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm run generate --prefix server
scripts.start: node -e "console.log('ENV KEYS:', Object.keys(process.env).includes('DATABASE_URL') ? 'DATABASE_URL IS SET' : 'DATABASE_URL IS MISSING')" && npm run migrate --prefix server && npm run seed --prefix server && npm start --prefix server
